            shape = {(y-top, x-left) for y,x in cells}
            comps.append((top, left, bottom-top+1, right-left+1, color, shape))

    # Keep the objects' original horizontal ordering, packing the upper group
    # across the top and the lower group along the bottom.
    comps.sort(key=lambda z: (z[0], z[1]))

            if 0 <= y0+dy < h and 0 <= x0+dx < w:
